name: Dollar Tree
description: Dollar Tree is a discount variety retailer operating about 9,000 stores in 48 states and DC plus about 275 in Canada (9,282 stores at 2026-01-31), selling consumables, variety goods and seasonal items at low fixed price points that now extend beyond $1 (multi-price). It sold its Family Dollar chain to a private buyer on 2025-07-05 for about $793M of total cash generated and now reports Dollar Tree as its single segment, with Family Dollar shown only as discontinued operations. Money is the markup on goods bought largely from overseas suppliers, so gross margin (36.4 percent) moves with import costs, tariffs and freight. Fiscal 2025 sales were $19.4B, up 10.4 percent, with a 5.3 percent comparable store sales gain.
